hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Accumulation
hints.text: The product of all elements except grid[i][j] equals the product of all elements appearing before it in row-major order multiplied by the product of all elements after it.

hints.title: Two Pass Matrix Sweep
hints.text: First pass computes prefix products, second pass in reverse computes suffix products, multiplying them into each matrix cell.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two linear scans over the grid cells.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing products without prefix/suffix arrays requires O(n^2 * m^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra auxiliary space beyond the output matrix.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Flatten matrix traversal into prefix and suffix product passes.
